title: Establish operator-owned provider trust
scope: Move executable selection, credential binding, and approved provider origins outside repository-controlled configuration before enterprise or untrusted-repository adoption.
acceptance_criteria: A checked-in repository cannot select an arbitrary ambient secret, send it to an unapproved origin, or execute an arbitrary provider command merely by starting the control plane.
The design retains an explicit path for approved GitHub Enterprise origins and approved Codex executables without storing credentials in the repository.
overlap_resolution: WI-0032 owns federation Git SECURITY sections; WI-0033 owns provider-trust SECURITY sections and remains out of Build pending approval.
WI-0118 owns only terminal and concluded eligibility behavior in src/codex-app-server-provider.mjs; WI-0033 retains provider trust and transport authority design.
unresolved: Product decision required: choose the operator-local approval model for provider origins, credential handles, executable path and argument pinning before Build.
